title: Eventsia
description: Eventsia is a Minecraft Event plugin that lets you easily set up & run server events with simple commands.
body:
# INFORMATION:
**Eventsia** is a simple and effective **Minecraft plugin** which enhances the ease of organizing and managing Minecraft **events**. It can be used for managing custom mini-games, parkour challenges, or even PvP tournaments. With Eventsia, you can have complete control over participants, event worlds, and event organization.

Eventsia offers automated spectator management and simple commands, making it easy to run your events without the need for additional plugins or complex setups.

# 💎Default player Commands:
/event - teleport to the event if the event is started.
/event leave - if you're in the event and want to leave
# 🥇Admin Commands:
/event message - send the message so people notice there's gonna be an event.
/event blacklist - blacklist somone from joining events
/event start - command to start the event.
/event stop - to stop the event after it's done.
/event unblacklist - to remove blacklisted players so they can join the event again.
# ❗Imporant Admin Commands:
/event setworld - Set the world the event is in, if you don't do it the event starting wont work.
/event setcoords - Set the coordinates where people spawn when they do /event ex. 0 70 0
if you don't do it the event starting wont work.
# 🔒Permissions:
- Admin: event.startrun
- Everyone has access to the other commands.
